decision.description:
Label identifiers validation statuses.
- `imei` - `filled` — Label identifier is added to the assembly order, validation is not required - `deadlineExceeded` — Label identifier validation is not completed and will continue. The validation can pass or fail - `optional` — Label identifier is not required. Validation passed - `imeiMaySell` — The item is approved for sale. Validation passed - `imeiSoldB2B` — The item was sold to a B2B buyer and approved for sale again. Validation passed - `pending` — Label identifier validation continues. Wait for the validation status to change - `required` — Required label identifier is not added to the assembly order. Validation failed - `imeiInvalidFormat` — Invalid format. Validation failed - `imeiAlreadySold` — The item with this IMEI has already been sold. Validation failed - `uin` - `filled` — Label identifier is added to the assembly order, validation is not required - `optional` — Label identifier is not required. Validation passed - `required` — Required label identifier is not added to the assembly order. Validation failed - `sgtin` - `filled` — Label identifier is added to the assembly order, validation is not required - `deadlineExceeded` — Label identifier validation is not completed and will continue. The validation can pass or fail - `optional` — Label identifier is not required. Validation passed - `sgtinIntroduced` — The item is approved for sale. Validation passed - `sgtinSoldB2B` — The item was sold to a B2B buyer and approved for sale again. Validation passed - `pending` — Label identifier validation continues. Wait for the validation status to change - `required` — Required label identifier is not added to the assembly order. Validation failed - `sgtinInvalidFormat` — Invalid format. Validation failed - `sgtinNotFound` — Label identifier not found in [Chestny ZNAK](https://chestnyznak.ru/en/). Validation failed - `sgtinEmitted` — Label identifier has been issued. Validation failed - `sgtinApplied` — Putting into circulation not completed. Validation failed - `sgtinWrittenOff` — Written off. Validation failed - `sgtinRetired` — Retired. Validation failed - `sgtinWithdrawn` — Withdrawn. Validation failed - `sgtinDisaggregated` — Disaggregated. Validation failed - `sgtinDisaggregation` — Disaggregation. Validation failed - `sgtinAppliedNotPaid` — Not paid. Validation failed - `gtin` - `filled` — Label identifier is added to the assembly order, validation is not required - `optional` — Label identifier is not required. Validation passed - `required` — Required label identifier is not added to the assembly order. Validation failed - `customsDeclaration` - `filled` — Label identifier is added to the assembly order, validation is not required - `optional` — Label identifier is not required. Validation passed - `required` — Required label identifier is not added to the assembly order. Validation failed

post.description:
The method provides the statuses of [assembly orders](/openapi/in-store-pickup#tag/inStorePickupAssemblyOrders) by their ID.

`supplierStatus` — the status of the assembly order. The trigger for its change is the action of the seller himself. Possible values for `supplierStatus`: | Status | Description | How to set the assembly order to this status | |---------------------|----------------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------| | `new` | **New assembly order** || | `confirm` | **In assembly** | [Transfer to assembly](/openapi/in-store-pickup#tag/inStorePickupAssemblyOrders/operation/postV3ClickCollectOrdersStatusConfirm) | | `prepare` | **Ready for pickup** | [Notify that the assembly order is ready for delivery](/openapi/in-store-pickup#tag/inStorePickupAssemblyOrders/operation/postV3ClickCollectOrdersStatusPrepare) | | `receive` | **Received by buyer** | [Notify that the order has been received by the buyer](/openapi/in-store-pickup#tag/inStorePickupAssemblyOrders/operation/postV3ClickCollectOrdersStatusReceive) | | `reject` | **Buyer refusal** | [Notify that the buyer has declined the order](/openapi/in-store-pickup#tag/inStorePickupAssemblyOrders/operation/postV3ClickCollectOrdersStatusReject) | | `cancel` | **Canceled by seller** | [Cancel the order](/openapi/in-store-pickup#tag/inStorePickupAssemblyOrders/operation/postV3ClickCollectOrdersStatusCancel) | | `cancel_shelf_life` | **Canceled due to shelf life expiration** | Automatically transitions upon event occurrence | `wbStatus` — the status of the assembly order in the WB system. Possible values for wbStatus: - `waiting` - assembly order is in progress - `sorted` - assembly order is sorted - `sold` - the buyer got the order - `canceled` - assembly order canceled - `canceled_by_client` - buyer canceled the order upon receipt - `declined_by_client` - buyer canceled the order within the first hour
Cancellation is available to the buyer within the first hour from the time of order, if the order has not been transitioned to assembly - `defect` - order canceled due to defect - `ready_for_pickup` - order is ready for pickup
